details.summary: This is an exceptional, ready-to-publish recipe. It brilliantly utilizes ready-to-eat quinoa and canned beans to deliver a complex, protein-rich Mediterranean skillet meal well under the 30-minute threshold, perfectly satisfying both the culinary and nutritional demands of the book.

dimensions.feedback: The flavor profile is excellent. The smoky paprika, garlic, and tomato create a classic Spanish-inspired base (reminiscent of huevos a la flamenca), while the red wine vinegar adds necessary acidity and the Greek yogurt provides a creamy, cooling finish.
All listed ingredients are used in the instructions exactly as stated, and no unlisted ingredients appear in the steps.

The instructions are thorough and well-cued, providing proper time ranges (2 to 3 minutes; 5 to 7 minutes), a specific mid-point check for the eggs, and clear visual cues for doneness (fragrant, wilted, firmly set whites with soft yolks).
The recipe aligns perfectly with its Spanish-inspired Mediterranean billing, utilizing olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, tomatoes, and beans.
A stovetop covered skillet is the ideal, proven method for gently poaching eggs in a thick tomato and bean base.
The calculated nutrition accurately reflects the ingredients. Protein (30.5 g) correctly accounts for the eggs, yogurt, beans, and quinoa, while the saturated fat remains within limits.
The title accurately reflects the main components of the dish. The intro is warm, practical, and focuses appropriately on fiber and lasting fullness without using banned 'diet' or 'detox' claims.
This is a highly appealing, comforting, and visually attractive one-pan meal that feels robust and satisfying.
Genuinely serves both conditions well. It provides plenty of vegetable volume and fiber for fatty liver, while delivering steady, complex carbohydrates alongside lean proteins to manage blood sugar.
Perfectly balanced. Zero added sugars, and the carbohydrate load (45.3 g) falls squarely in the target window, sourced entirely from high-quality whole foods (beans and quinoa).

An exemplary fit for the 'Vegetable & Meatless Dinners' chapter. It successfully hits the challenging >=26g meatless protein target by smartly combining legumes, quinoa, eggs, and Greek yogurt, while staying perfectly within the calorie, saturated fat, and sodium parameters.

Comfortably achievable in under 30 minutes from a cold start. The use of a ready-to-eat cooked quinoa pouch is a first-class strategy to meet the strict time constraint using easily accessible supermarket ingredients.
